set.body:
Canonical pre-publication acceptance for PRD A-1 through A-27 and foundation M6; also absorbs the old ms-v10 stability alias. Do not add scientific features merely to broaden the release.

Produce a SHA-bound requirement/evidence matrix on the current candidate. Cover: complete required eyesim baseline workflows with independently justified disagreements; task-first executable docs and isolated consumer usability; typed plan/codec persistence, exact artifact identity, invalid/unknown schema and migration/refusal tests; downstream comparison and detector/smoother extensions and headless application consumption; declared numerical contracts, laws, mutations, negative-type tests, supported JVM/Scala.js checks, boundaries and scientific regressions. Require existing M2-M5 receipts and refresh only stale or invalidated evidence.

Record a representative recording/study workload, input size, elapsed time, memory and practical support limits on a named environment; the Studio latency court may supply overlapping evidence only when it exercises the required workload. Include compatibility/schema-evolution policy, module dependencies, support limits and migration guidance. Resolve the named all-module Scaladoc runtime ticket or document a qualified supported-runtime/workaround route with precise scope.

A-11: v-asc-e2e and asc-public-fixture/asc-public-e2e are closed and landed. They qualify the permitted complete public EDF-derived ASC through portable import and Scanpath, with unknown converter/original-EDF fields explicit. Do not reintroduce the broader vendor dual-oracle certification programme as an initial-release prerequisite.

Publication boundary: this ticket closes when scientific/architectural/consumer/operational acceptance and the candidate documentation are ready for publication. The matrix must identify A-16 external publication and first-baseline verification as pending until rel-publish and rel-mima supply their receipts. Those tickets block the library release group and joint 1.0 root. This pre-publication audit never claims that Central publication already occurred.
set.title: Library: consolidated pre-publication acceptance (M6, PRD A-1–A-27)
